annotations.text:
A — Show Ledger
List-first, closest to your existing road-trip pages. Everything is one editable table; map + deadlines ride the right rail. Best if the spreadsheet is really the product.
Tradeoff: the route is secondary.

B — Season Board
Data-first dashboard. Gantt of the whole season with apply-by markers, so overlaps and deadline crunches are visible at a glance.
Tradeoff: densest to build and to edit in.

C — Route First
Map is the page; itinerary in date order beside it; editing happens in a panel on the right.
Tradeoff: less good for 30+ shows or deadline triage.
